feature_flag: read facade and local stdio seam each require enabled: true (exact boolean) plus an explicitly injected facade/provider binding; default OFF
authority_notes: Contract data, a read-only in-memory dispatch facade, and an unbound local newline-delimited JSON-RPC stdio seam. The seam discovers no provider or filesystem, exposes only the 21 contract read tools, is OFF unless constructed with enabled: true plus an injected facade, and maps all unservable tool calls to the facade's uniform outcomes. It grants no mutation, task/context/artifact/review/acceptance authority. Wiring real providers or client configuration stays a separate leaf behind D27/D28/D29 and OD-08 gates.
